prompt:
Customers have been complaining about checkout totals in our `pricing/` package. This week's reports:

- "My cart was exactly $50 and I still got charged shipping."
- "I entered two 10%-off codes and got way more than 10% off."
- "I pasted my coupon code with a trailing space from an email and it just silently didn't apply - no error, nothing."
- One of our engineers noticed something weirder: right after a one-off script applied a coupon to a test cart, a brand-new `Cart()` created afterwards in the same process already showed that coupon in `applied_codes` before anything was called on it.

`pricing/README.md` is the source of truth for exactly how discounts, coupon stacking, rounding, and shipping are supposed to work - please make the code match it. Don't change the public class/function names (`Cart`, `build_receipt`, etc.) or the shape of the receipt dict, since other code imports and depends on them as-is.
